title: Chorreadas
hookLine: Global-inspired chorreadas with 9 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Chorreadas
steps.instructionTemplate: Using a food processor or a blender, combine all the ingredients, don't overdo it, the mixture should be crumby. Keep {m53542_1}, {m53542_2}, {m53542_3}, and {m53542_4} prepped and measured within reach so each step comes together smoothly and evenly.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure sweetcorn first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Chorreadas
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat a lightly oiled pan over medium-high heat. Pour 1/4 cup of the batter onto the pan. Cook until lightly brown on each side, just like making pancakes ;). Incorporate {m53542_5} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Chorreadas
steps.instructionTemplate: Traditionally you serve it with a spoon of sour cream on top. I just prefer to eat it plain. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

steps.title: Cool 1 Minute on Rack & Plate
steps.instructionTemplate: Transfer Chorreadas onto a wire rack for 60 seconds so steam escapes and the outside stays crisp. Top with {m53542_6}, {m53542_7}, {m53542_8}, and {m53542_9} and serve immediately into 4 portions.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 15 mins!
